components.name: detector-span-validation
components.rationale: Detector output and span validation feed the privacy pipeline; workspace tests cover downstream consumers.

components.name: policy-planning
components.rationale: Policy decisions and plan validation must remain fail closed across the workspace.

components.name: transformer-postconditions
components.rationale: Workspace tests verify postconditions, mappings, and downstream pipeline behavior.

components.name: vault-persistence-and-key-handling
components.rationale: Vault persistence, scope isolation, and key handling are exercised by crate and consumer tests.

components.name: placeholder-parsing
components.rationale: Placeholder parsing and resolution cross the shared API, process protocol, and pipeline.

components.name: process-plugin-lifecycle
components.rationale: Workspace tests cover process startup, protocol failures, lifecycle, and recovery.

components.name: mcp-framing-and-dispatch
components.rationale: The workspace tests cover framing, dispatch, CLI configuration, and consumer behavior.

components.name: audit-integrity
components.rationale: Audit chain, refusal, and adapter behavior are tested across the workspace.

components.name: configuration-loading
components.rationale: Config parsing and plugin registration affect the CLI and all configured consumers.

components.name: shared-plugin-api
components.rationale: The test sensor runs the full workspace, so API consumers are checked with the changed contract.

path_rules.name: detector-quality-corpus
path_rules.rationale: The synthetic corpus is compiled into detector quality tests.

path_rules.name: mcp-threat-fixtures
path_rules.rationale: The MCP threat-case JSON is consumed by Rust integration tests.

path_rules.name: process-plugin-fixtures
path_rules.rationale: Process fixtures are executed by Rust tests and shell fixtures also require ShellCheck.

path_rules.name: fuzz-workspace
path_rules.rationale: The fuzz crate is excluded from the root Cargo workspace; fuzz-check runs its format, lint, compile, and seed-corpus checks.

path_rules.name: shared-skill-integration-test
path_rules.rationale: The skills sensor runs this integration suite through scripts/check-skills.sh.

path_rules.name: shared-skill-test-fixtures
path_rules.rationale: The skills sensor runs these adopter fixtures through scripts/check-skills.sh.

path_rules.name: crate-readme-metadata
path_rules.rationale: Package README presence and archive inclusion are checked by release-preflight.

path_rules.name: crate-manifests
path_rules.rationale: Crate manifests affect workspace builds and publication metadata.
